status BOUND. W = {e, e * D : e | 2u}. witness = the smaller of D and 2u (they tie exactly, because D * 2u = m and T_minus(d) = T_minus(m/d)). upper bound = e_minus(witness). lower bound = F_minus(r_M). bin NEAR_FLOOR, bin_at_least NEAR_FLOOR, boundary_flag false. CONSISTENCY: the upper bound equals, within 10^-50, the EXACT minus exponent of C-PLANT-M from the same stage (its minimiser lies in {D, 2u} by that control's gate).

status BOUND. W = {e * (product of S) : e | 2, S a subset of {2d, 3w}} = {1, 2, 2d, 4d, 3w, 6w, 6dw, 12dw}. witness = 2d. upper bound = e_plus(2d). lower bound = F_plus(r_P). bin NEAR_FLOOR, bin_at_least NEAR_FLOOR, boundary_flag false. import yaml,hashlib,json
A='experiments/EXP-AUXIN-7e2e3d/amendments/'
t=yaml.safe_load(open(A+'AMD-20260926-typed.yaml'))['amendment']
n=yaml.safe_load(open(A+'AMD-20260927-narrow.yaml'))['amendment']
g=yaml.safe_load(open(A+'AMD-20260928-gated.yaml'))['amendment']
v1=yaml.safe_load(open('experiments/EXP-AUXIN-7e2e3d/specification.yaml'))['experiment']
H=lambda s: hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()
cb=[c for c in t['controls'] if c['id']=='C-BOUND'][0]
st={s['id']:s for s in cb['states']}
val={'G-GATE1':cb['gates'][0],'G-BND1':st['BND-1']['expected'],'G-BND3':st['BND-3']['expected'],
     'G-Q011':t['conventions']['Q0-11'],'G-CPL':n['corrective']['declared_not_superseded'][0]['declaration'],
     'G-WII':n['incorporates']['what_is_incorporated'],'G-ENV':n['envelope_not_incorporated']['rule']}
out={}
for r in g['gated_span_rules']:
    v=val[r['id']]; c=v.count(r['from']); i=v.find(r['from']); j=v.find(r['through'],i)
    span=v[i:j+len(r['through'])]
    after=v[:i]+r['replacement']+v[j+len(r['through']):]
    out[r['id']]={'from_occurrences':c,'span':span,'sha256':H(span),'declared':r['replaced_span_sha256'],'match':H(span)==r['replaced_span_sha256'],'resulting_text':after}
    print(r['id'],c,H(span)==r['replaced_span_sha256']); print('   AFTER:',after,'\n')
pl=[c for c in t['controls'] if c['id']=='C-PLANT-PL'][0]['declared_properties']
q="Hence the plus minimiser is D_L, uniquely, and e_plus - F_plus is below 10^-6 by a wide margin."
out['ER-5_quote']={'in_source_count':pl.count(q),'sha256':H(q),'declared':'a0fad262cb56745a8de22412c1ebc03671c8daa40dfaa23992cd98e53af19bff'}
q3=v1['tail_checks'][0]
out['ER-3_quote']={'source':q3,'sha256':H(q3),'declared':'26b53f8995afb04335a24612dcf48e736a2dd0e3d72d5f9b6b440b1a13cc5e52','quoted_in_gated':q3 in g['corrective']['falsification_condition_mapping_fc6']['outcome']}
print(json.dumps({k:out[k] for k in ('ER-5_quote','ER-3_quote')},indent=1))
json.dump(out,open('/Volumes/SSD990/tmp/rt-fa61f4/spans_out.json','w'),indent=1)
